S.FORM: O ratoh a sowal no liteng ko niyaro' no Kiwat Itiya no to'asan ho, ira ci Sera "fa'inay", ci Nakaw "fafahi" kawas a tamdaw malokelon tayni i Tawrayan hananay a pala "Itini i Posko ceroh a niyaro' anini" saciwawa sa ci Tapang Masera "fa'inayan", ci Nakaw "fafahiyan" tatosa ko wawa, awaay ko kihar a ma'orip. nika ira ko cecay a romi'ad kafahalan malenlen tata'ak ko nanom, toya pikilim nangra tatosa to salikaka i kalingadan, mingata to ko nanom, mahaop to ko paloma'an, awaen to ko fafanaen cakat sato talakakarayan cangra a tatosa. oya malingaday a malekakaay manengneng ko lenlen o 'alol to, o patay to saan ko faloco', papasayra to koya nanom cangraan, makera nangra mahecaday o toptop no sapakaen to fafoy mapawpaw pasayra cangraan, taroh tengtewng han nangra kalic han to, pakonira han to nangra ko nika pawpaw. paherekan mapawpaw tahira i sasinang no Cilangasan no lotok, ikor to itira sato cangra patireng to loma', itira to pamatang mimawmah to sota, o palomaan nangra i o mikafitay toya dodan a hafay, onini to ko kakaenen nangra. Ikor to mararamod to kona malekakaay tatosa 'aro sato itira, nika 'adihay ko 'oner itini, caay kangaay matenes itini a maro', orasaka na i lotokay mafolaw to tayra paloma' i Kalala, nika itini sa awaay ko kamawmahan, maroray itini maro', saikoray to mafolaw to tayni toni aniniay a Kiwit a niyaro'. Kafafaed a lotok no Kalala, o Sapat a niyaro', toni a niyaro' anini no Sapat i laloma, tatihi no lalan sakatayra i Posong ato Kalingko, kawali a lotok ira ko masahecekay a sapad no fokeloh, doedoen ko sowal no itiniay a finacadan a tamdaw, na iraay ko toptop no pafafoyan mana'ang itini ato talalikan, nika ira ko pamatangay i kaDipongan ho makari'ang. saka iora kosowal no lihaf, oya tadamaanay a lalosidan pinana'ang no i Kiwitay a tenod, ora i'ayaway maro' i Cilangasan a Kiwit tamdaw, na icowaay kahofocan a pala kafokilan a tamdaw tayra i Makotaay, o na ihawikidan ya tayni, o fana' no finacadan a tamdaw itiya i o pisamaradan, mitenooy, ato pitolon alikakawa, saheto naitiraay mapawpaw mapatayni, o 'idoc, po'ot, silingsiling naitiraan kafokilan a niyaro', sacingangan sa ci Alin mihawikidan, ikor to o itiniay to a tamdaw ci Do'ic ko micakayay sa.

"itini i po~usko~u ʦəro~uħ a nijaro~uʡ anini" saʦiwawa sa ʦi tapaŋ masəra "faʡinajan", ʦi nakaw "fafaħijan" tato~usa ko~u wawa, awaaj ko~u kiħar a maʡo~urip. nika ira ko~u ʦəʦaj a ro~umiʡaɬ~ɮ kafaħaɾan maɾənɾən tataʡak ko~u nano~um, to~uja pikiɾim naŋra tato~usa to~u saɾikaka i kaɾiŋaɬ~ɮan, miŋata to~u ko~u nano~um, maħao~up to~u ko~u paɾo~umaʡan, awaən to~u ko~u fafanaən ʦakat sato~u taɾakakarajan ʦaŋra a tato~usa. o~uja maɾiŋaɬ~ɮaj a maɾəkakaaj manəŋnəŋ ko~u ɾənɾən o~u ʡaɾo~uɾ to~u, o~u pataj to~u saan ko~u faɾo~uʦo~uʡ, papasajra to~u ko~uja nano~um ʦaŋraan, makəra naŋra maħəʦaɬ~ɮaj o~u to~upto~up no~u sapakaən to~u fafo~uj mapawpaw pasajra ʦaŋraan, taro~uħ təŋtəwŋ ħan naŋra kaɾiʦ ħan to~u, pako~unira ħan to~u naŋra ko~u nika pawpaw. paħərəkan mapawpaw taħira i sasinaŋ no~u ʦiɾaŋasan no~u ɾo~uto~uk, iko~ur to~u itira sato~u ʦaŋra patirəŋ to~u ɾo~umaʡ, itira to~u pamataŋ mimawmaħ to~u so~uta, o~u paɾo~umaan naŋra i o~u mikafitaj to~uja ɬ~ɮo~uɬ~ɮan a ħafaj, o~unini to~u ko~u kakaənən naŋra. iko~ur to~u mararamo~uɬ~ɮ to~u ko~una maɾəkakaaj tato~usa ʡaro~u sato~u itira, nika ʡaɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u ʡo~unər itini, ʦaaj kaŋaaj matənəs itini a maro~uʡ, o~urasaka na i ɾo~uto~ukaj mafo~uɾaw to~u tajra paɾo~umaʡ i kaɾaɾa, nika itini sa awaaj ko~u kamawmaħan, maro~uraj itini maro~uʡ, saiko~uraj to~u mafo~uɾaw to~u tajni to~uni aniniaj a kiwit a nijaro~uʡ. kafafaəɬ~ɮ a ɾo~uto~uk no~u kaɾaɾa, o~u sapat a nijaro~uʡ, to~uni a nijaro~uʡ anini no~u sapat i ɾaɾo~uma, tatiħi no~u ɾaɾan sakatajra i po~uso~uŋ ato~u kaɾiŋko~u, kawaɾi a ɾo~uto~uk ira ko~u masaħəʦəkaj a sapaɬ~ɮ no~u fo~ukəɾo~uħ, ɬ~ɮo~uəɬ~ɮo~uən ko~u so~uwaɾ no~u itiniaj a finaʦaɬ~ɮan a tamɬ~ɮaw, na iraaj ko~u to~upto~up no~u pafafo~ujan manaʡaŋ itini ato~u taɾaɾikan, nika ira ko~u pamataŋaj i kaɬ~ɮipo~uŋan ħo~u makariʡaŋ. saka io~ura ko~uso~uwaɾ no~u ɾiħaf, o~uja taɬ~ɮamaanaj a ɾaɾo~usiɬ~ɮan pinanaʡaŋ no~u i kiwitaj a təno~uɬ~ɮ, o~ura iʡajawaj maro~uʡ i ʦiɾaŋasan a kiwit tamɬ~ɮaw, na iʦo~uwaaj kaħo~ufo~uʦan a paɾa kafo~ukiɾan a tamɬ~ɮaw tajra i mako~utaaj, o~u na iħawikiɬ~ɮan ja tajni, o~u fanaʡ no~u finaʦaɬ~ɮan a tamɬ~ɮaw itija i o~u pisamaraɬ~ɮan, mitəno~uo~uj, ato~u pito~uɾo~un aɾikakawa, saħəto~u naitiraaj mapawpaw mapatajni, o~u ʡiɬ~ɮo~uʦ, po~uʡo~ut, siɾiŋsiɾiŋ naitiraan kafo~ukiɾan a nijaro~uʡ, saʦiŋaŋan sa ʦi aɾin miħawikiɬ~ɮan, iko~ur to~u o~u itiniaj to~u a tamɬ~ɮaw ʦi ɬ~ɮo~uʡiʦ ko~u miʦakajaj sa.
